In the Lok Sabha, if a party does not have a minimum of 75 members, its leader cannot be recognised as the Leader of the Opposition. Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.questionTextHi: निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें: 1. पहली लोकसभा में, विपक्ष में सबसे बड़ी पार्टी स्वतंत्र पार्टी थी। 2. लोकसभा में, "विपक्ष के नेता" को पहली बार 1969 में मान्यता दी गई थी। 3. लोकसभा में, यदि किसी पार्टी के पास न्यूनतम 75 सदस्य नहीं हैं, तो उसके नेता को विपक्ष के नेता के रूप में मान्यता नहीं दी जा सकती है। ऊपर दिए गए कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?

questions.questionTextHi: यदि किसी राज्य को लोकसभा में आवंटित सीटों की संख्या 42 है, तो उस राज्य में अनुसूचित जाति के लिए आरक्षित सीटों की संख्या होगी:
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (A). According to Article 330(2) the number of seats reserved in any State or Union territory for the Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribes under clause (1) shall be, as nearly as may be, the same proportion to the total number of seats allocated to that State/UT in the House of the People as the population SC/ST bears to the total population of the state/ UT. For example, in the year 1996 the number of Lok Sabha members in West Bengal and erstwhile Andhra Pradesh was 42, in which seats reserved for scheduled castes were 8 and 6 respectively. After delimitation in the year 2008, the reserved seats for scheduled caste in these two states is 10 and 7 respectively. Thus none of the above answer is correct.

questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (C). According to Article 81 of the Indian Constitution, the maximum number of members in Lok Sabha can be 550 (530 from states and 20 from Union territories). According to Article 331, notwithstanding anything in Article 81, the President, if he is of the opinion that the Anglo-Indian community is not adequately represented in the Lok Sabha, could nominate not more than two members of that community to the Lok Sabha. In the election for Lok Sabha or State Assembly, the winning candidate must get at least 50 percent of the votes polled, to be declared elected. 2. According to the provisions laid down in the Constitution of India, in Lok Sabha, the Speaker's post goes to the majority party and the Deputy Speaker's to the Opposition. Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.questionTextHi: निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें: 1. लोकसभा या राज्य विधानसभा के चुनाव में, निर्वाचित घोषित होने के लिए जीतने वाले उम्मीदवार को मतदान का कम से कम 50 प्रतिशत वोट प्राप्त करना होगा। 2. भारत के संविधान में निर्धारित प्रावधानों के अनुसार लोकसभा में अध्यक्ष का पद बहुमत दल को और उपाध्यक्ष का पद विपक्ष को मिलता है। ऊपर दिए गए कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (D). The election for Lok Sabha or state Assembly in India is conducted on the principle of 'First past the Post'. According to Article 93 of the Constitution, "the House of the people shall, as soon as may be, choose two members of the House to be respectively speaker and Deputy Speaker. Traditionally, the speaker's post goes to the majority and the Deputy speaker to the Opposition. However there is no such provision in the constitution. Therefore, statement 2 is also wrong.

questions.questionTextHi: 15वीं लोकसभा की महिला सदस्यों के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें - (i) वे कुल सदस्यों के 10% से कम हैं। (ii) उनमें से अधिकतम भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस के हैं। (iii) तीन सदस्य राजस्थान से चुने जाते हैं (iv) अधिकतम महिला सदस्य उत्तर प्रदेश से चुनी जाती हैं। कौन सा सत्य है/हैं -
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (A). In 17th Lok Sabha, the number of women members was more than 14% of the total number of members. There were total 78 women members out of which 6 were from Congress (INC) and 41 from BJP. The highest number of women were elected from Uttar Pradesh and West Bengal (11 from each).
